comparison.objective: Position a nickel strip on a 2×2 battery pack and spot-weld it at all four cells, then return the welding tool.
comparison.physical_skill: Thin-strip pickup and alignment, repeated precision placement of paired probe tips, controlled contact dwell, and tool retrieval/reseating.
comparison.success_condition: Strip alignment is within tolerance, all four weld locations receive valid paired-tip contact (with a real bond pull-test in real trials), the welder is returned, and the final still/released state holds for 1 s; damage/loss failures are specified. Simulation does not model heat or bond formation.
comparison.reason: This tests thin-part placement and repeated precision tool contact at fixed targets. It does not test sorting mixed free bodies by aperture geometry, clearing granular bridges, retaining washers, or achieving a recovered-mass threshold.
